regime_context: The rotation detector shows Memory/HBM & Storage as a dominant, crowded leader with a large margin over Silver Miners, but breadth of rotation is broad (57% eligible) and the headline one_narrative flag is false — this is a leadership-concentration regime, not a single crowded mononarrative. The absolute-trend gate is unbroken (all top ranks eligible) and gate_helps is true for US equities, so trend discipline is the one defensible reason to stay engaged; momentum rank itself has no documented forward edge.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Silver Miners (rank #2, breadth 0.75, uncrowded) closes the 1.44 score-gap to Memory/HBM over the next two weeks while keeping its breadth above 0.5 — a confirmed challenger handoff would only be retired from watch if SIL's breadth drops below 0.4 or the score-gap widens back above 1.6.

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Silver Miners rank #2 with strong durability (0.62) and the highest breadth among top eligible themes (0.75), with a clean crowding profile (z=0.45, not crowded). Unlike the crowded memory leader, this is a high-participation, uncrowded uptrend that has been validated by the trend gate — the one leg with a real forward edge for drawdown control.
evidence: breadth 0.75 vs 0.0 for the memory leader
theses.dissent: Silver miners are high-beta and sensitive to industrial demand; if the macro backdrop shifts to risk-off or the US dollar strengthens, the uncrowded breadth can collapse quickly, and the detector's rank reflects coincident momentum, not a forecast.

falsifier.text: SIL trades below its 20-day simple moving average for 5 consecutive sessions before the check-by date

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Memory is the clean leader (score 3.0, 1.44 margin over challenger) and trend-gate eligible, but it is crowded (z=1.39) with zero theme-level breadth (0.0) — leadership concentration on a few names. Per guardrails this is a cap-and-hold, not a conviction fade or add: the crowding flag is a size-down caution only, and the trend gate is intact.
theses.dissent: Concentrated leadership with zero breadth is fragile; a single SMH constituent earnings miss or an AI-capex pause can unwind the entire theme, and crowding at z=1.39 has historically marked thematic tops more often than continuations.

falsifier.text: SMH lags the S&P 500 by 5% or more before the check-by date

theses.subject: Energy (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Energy EW is eligible with a clean 'trend' hurst tag (the healthiest trend structure among top-5 ranks), moderate durability (0.52), and no crowding (z=0.84). It is a quieter, trend-gated uptrend that avoids the concentration risk of the memory leader and the mean-reversion fragility of AI Infrastructure.
theses.dissent: Energy is cyclical and hostage to crude supply surprises; unscheduled macro shock share is 0.87, and an OPEC surprise or demand scare could break the trend even though the gate is currently intact.

falsifier.text: XLE closes below its 50-day moving average on a weekly basis before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
